- `os_yum_repo_file_whitelist`
  - Default: `[]`
  - Description: List of yum repository files under /etc/yum.repos.d/ which should not be altered.
  - Type: list of ''
  - Required: no
- `proc_mnt_options`
  - Default: `rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,relatime`
  - Description: Mount proc with hardenized options. Note that the hidepid option is set separately in vars/.
  - Type: str
  - Required: no
- `sysctl_config`
  - Default: `{"fs.protected_hardlinks": 1, "fs.protected_symlinks": 1, "fs.protected_fifos": 1, "fs.protected_regular": 2, "fs.suid_dumpable": 0, "kernel.core_uses_pid": 1, "kernel.kptr_restrict": 2, "kernel.kexec_load_disabled": 1, "kernel.sysrq": 0, "kernel.randomize_va_space": 2, "kernel.yama.ptrace_scope": 2, "net.ipv4.ip_forward": 0, "net.ipv6.conf.all.forwarding": 0, "net.ipv4.conf.all.rp_filter": 1, "net.ipv4.conf.default.rp_filter": 1, "net.ipv4.icmp_echo_ignore_broadcasts": 1, "net.ipv4.icmp_ignore_bogus_error_responses": 1, "net.ipv4.icmp_ratelimit": 100, "net.ipv4.icmp_ratemask": 88089, "net.ipv4.tcp_timestamps": 0, "net.ipv4.conf.all.arp_ignore": 1, "net.ipv4.conf.all.arp_announce": 2, "net.ipv4.tcp_rfc1337": 1, "net.ipv4.tcp_syncookies": 1, "net.ipv4.conf.all.shared_media": 1, "net.ipv4.conf.default.shared_media": 1, "net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route": 0, "net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route": 0, "net.ipv6.conf.all.accept_source_route": 0, "net.ipv6.conf.default.accept_source_route": 0, "net.ipv4.conf.all.send_redirects": 0, "net.ipv4.conf.default.send_redirects": 0, "net.ipv4.conf.all.log_martians": 1, "net.ipv4.conf.default.log_martians": 1, "net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects": 0, "net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects": 0, "net.ipv4.conf.all.secure_redirects": 0, "net.ipv4.conf.default.secure_redirects": 0, "net.ipv6.conf.default.accept_redirects": 0, "net.ipv6.conf.all.accept_redirects": 0, "net.ipv6.conf.all.accept_ra": 0, "net.ipv6.conf.default.accept_ra": 0, "net.ipv6.conf.default.router_solicitations": 0, "net.ipv6.conf.all.router_solicitations": 0, "net.ipv6.conf.default.accept_ra_rtr_pref": 0, "net.ipv6.conf.default.accept_ra_pinfo": 0, "net.ipv6.conf.default.accept_ra_defrtr": 0, "net.ipv6.conf.default.autoconf": 0, "net.ipv6.conf.all.autoconf": 0, "net.ipv6.conf.default.dad_transmits": 0, "net.ipv6.conf.default.max_addresses": 1, "vm.mmap_min_addr": 65536, "vm.mmap_rnd_bits": 32, "vm.mmap_rnd_compat_bits": 16}`
  - Description: various sysctl-settings
  - Type: dict
  - Required: no
- `sysctl_overwrite`
  - Default: `"{}"`
  - Description: To overwrite options in the `sysctl_config`-dict, overwrite them here.
  - Type: dict
  - Required: no
- `ufw_default_application_policy`
  - Default: `SKIP`
  - Description: The default application policy is skip, which means that the update --add-new command will do nothing
  - Type: str
  - Required: no
- `ufw_default_forward_policy`
  - Default: `DROP`
  - Description: set default forward policy of ufw to `DROP`.
  - Type: str
  - Required: no
- `ufw_default_input_policy`
  - Default: `DROP`
  - Description: set default input policy of ufw to `DROP`.
  - Type: str
  - Required: no
- `ufw_default_output_policy`
  - Default: `ACCEPT`
  - Description: set default output policy of ufw to `ACCEPT`.
  - Type: str
  - Required: no
- `ufw_enable_ipv6`
  - Default: `True`
  - Description: Set to `true` to apply rules to support IPv6 (no means only IPv6 on loopback accepted).
  - Type: bool
  - Required: no
- `ufw_ipt_modules`
  - Default: `nf_conntrack_ftp nf_nat_ftp nf_conntrack_netbios_ns`
  - Description: Define which netfilter modules to load
  - Type: str
  - Required: no
- `ufw_ipt_sysctl`
  - Default: `''`
  - Description: by default it disables IPT_SYSCTL in /etc/default/ufw. If you want to overwrite /etc/sysctl.conf values using ufw - set it to your sysctl dictionary, for example `/etc/ufw/sysctl.conf`.
  - Type: str
  - Required: no
- `ufw_manage_builtins`
  - Default: `no`
  - Description: If this variable is set to 'yes', on stop and reload the built-in chains are flushed. If it is set to 'no', on stop and reload the ufw secondary chains are removed and the ufw primary chains are flushed
  - Type: str
  - Required: no
- `ufw_manage_defaults`
  - Default: `True`
  - Description: true means apply all settings with `ufw_` prefix.
  - Type: bool
  - Required: no

## Dependencies

None.

## Example Playbook

```
- hosts: all
  become: true
  roles:
    - name: devsec.hardening.os_hardening
```

---
- name: Verify baseline comparison reports on three distributions
  hosts: all
  become: true
  gather_facts: true
  tasks:
    - name: Read the host hardening report
      ansible.builtin.slurp:
        src: /var/log/devsec-hardening/hardening-baseline.json
      register: hardening_report_raw

    - name: Parse the host hardening report
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        hardening_report: "{{ hardening_report_raw.content | b64decode | from_json }}"

    - name: Select login.defs changes
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        pass_max_days_change: >-
          {{
            hardening_report.changes
            | selectattr('id', 'equalto', 'login_defs.PASS_MAX_DAYS')
            | list
          }}
        umask_change: >-
          {{
            hardening_report.changes
            | selectattr('id', 'equalto', 'login_defs.UMASK')
            | list
          }}
        login_defs_file_change: >-
          {{
            hardening_report.file_changes
            | selectattr('path', 'equalto', '/etc/login.defs')
            | list
          }}

    - name: Verify the report identifies the changed configuration items
      ansible.builtin.assert:
        that:
          - hardening_report.host == inventory_hostname
          - hardening_report.distribution == ansible_facts.distribution
          - hardening_report.roles.os_hardening is defined
          - pass_max_days_change | length == 1
          - pass_max_days_change[0].before == '99999'
          - pass_max_days_change[0].after == '60'
          - umask_change | length == 1
          - umask_change[0].before == '022'
          - umask_change[0].after == umask_change[0].expected
          - login_defs_file_change | length == 1
          - login_defs_file_change[0].diff | length > 0
          - hardening_report.noncompliant | length == 0
        fail_msg: >-
          The baseline report did not accurately describe the changes on
          {{ ansible_facts.distribution }} {{ ansible_facts.distribution_version }}

---
driver:
  name: docker
platforms:
  - name: audit-debian13
    image: rndmh3ro/docker-debian13-ansible:latest

    privileged: true
    cgroupns_mode: host
    pre_build_image: true
  - name: audit-ubuntu2404

    command: /lib/systemd/systemd
    volumes:
      - /sys/fs/cgroup:/sys/fs/cgroup:rw
    privileged: true
    cgroupns_mode: host
    pre_build_image: true
  - name: audit-almalinux9
    image: rndmh3ro/docker-almalinux9-ansible:latest
    command: /lib/systemd/systemd
    volumes:
      - /sys/fs/cgroup:/sys/fs/cgroup:rw
    privileged: true
    cgroupns_mode: host
    pre_build_image: true

+Internal shared role used by `os_hardening`, `ssh_hardening`,
+`mysql_hardening` and `nginx_hardening`. It captures a baseline before a role
+changes the host, captures the same resources afterwards and writes an item
+level comparison to:
+
+```text
+/var/log/devsec-hardening/hardening-baseline.json
+```
+
+Reports from multiple roles are merged by host. Existing role variables remain
+the source of expected values; no duplicate compliance settings are required.
+
+## Variables
+
+- `hardening_audit_enabled` (default: `true`): enable capture and reporting.
+- `hardening_audit_fail_on_noncompliance` (default: `false`): fail after the
+  report is written when at least one expected value is not met.
+- `hardening_audit_report_file`: per-host report path.
+- `hardening_audit_command_timeout` (default: `30`): timeout for commands such
+  as `sshd -T` and `nginx -t`.
+- `hardening_audit_show_summary` (default: `true`): print changed and
+  noncompliant counts at the end of each role.
+- `hardening_audit_fetch_report` (default: `false`): fetch the report to the
+  control node.
+- `hardening_audit_controller_report_dir`: fetch destination.
+
+The report contains:
+
+- `baseline.before` and `baseline.after` file hashes, modes and ownership.
+- `changes`: exact options, before/after values and expected values.
+- `file_changes`: unified diffs for every changed file.
+- `noncompliant`: checks whose post-hardening value differs from the role
+  variable.
+- `checks` and `summary`: full check state and counts.
+
+The report intentionally contains no timestamps. A second run with no
+configuration change does not rewrite the report.

+
+## Hardening baseline comparison and compliance reports
+
+The four hardening roles automatically capture the relevant configuration
+before they change a host and compare it after they finish. Expected values are
+read from the existing role variables, so existing playbooks keep the same
+override behaviour and do not need a second set of compliance settings.
+
+Each host receives a merged report at
+`/var/log/devsec-hardening/hardening-baseline.json`. It contains:
+
+- before/after hashes, modes and ownership for every captured file;
+- item level changes with the old value, new value and expected value;
+- unified diffs for changed files, including lines not covered by a named check;
+- a `noncompliant` list for values that still differ from the role variables;
+- per-role and aggregate summaries.
+
+The following shared variables control reporting:
+
+```yaml
+hardening_audit_enabled: true
+hardening_audit_fail_on_noncompliance: false
+hardening_audit_report_file: /var/log/devsec-hardening/hardening-baseline.json
+hardening_audit_command_timeout: 30
+hardening_audit_show_summary: true
+hardening_audit_fetch_report: false
+hardening_audit_controller_report_dir: "{{ playbook_dir }}/hardening-reports"
+```
+
+Set `hardening_audit_fail_on_noncompliance: true` for a strict pipeline. The
+report is written before the role fails. SSH and nginx additionally validate
+their effective configuration with `sshd -T` and `nginx -t`.
+
+The report has no timestamp and is only rewritten when a role produces a new
+configuration change. Re-running an already hardened host therefore produces no
+new file change and leaves the original comparison available.
+
+The acceptance scenario runs against Debian 13, Ubuntu 24.04 and AlmaLinux 9:
+
+```shell
+molecule test -s hardening_audit
+```

---
name: "devsec.hardening_audit"
on:  # yamllint disable-line rule:truthy
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [master]
    paths:
      - 'plugins/modules/hardening_audit.py'
      - 'roles/hardening_audit/**'
      - 'roles/*/vars/audit.yml'
      - 'molecule/hardening_audit/**'
      - '.github/workflows/hardening_audit.yml'
      - 'requirements.txt'

    branches: [master]
    paths:
      - 'plugins/modules/hardening_audit.py'

      - 'molecule/hardening_audit/**'
      - '.github/workflows/hardening_audit.yml'
      - 'requirements.txt'

    - cron: '0 7 * * 3'

concurrency:

+## Hardening baseline comparison and compliance reports
+
+The four hardening roles automatically capture the relevant configuration
+before they change a host and compare it after they finish. Expected values are
+read from the existing role variables, so existing playbooks keep the same
+override behaviour and do not need a second set of compliance settings.
+
+Each host receives a merged report at
+`/var/log/devsec-hardening/hardening-baseline.json`. It contains:
+
+- before/after hashes, modes and ownership for every captured file;
+- item level changes with the old value, new value and expected value;
+- unified diffs for changed files, including lines not covered by a named check;
+- a `noncompliant` list for values that still differ from the role variables;
+- per-role and aggregate summaries.
+
+The following shared variables control reporting:
+
+```yaml
+hardening_audit_enabled: true
+hardening_audit_fail_on_noncompliance: false
+hardening_audit_report_file: /var/log/devsec-hardening/hardening-baseline.json
+hardening_audit_command_timeout: 30
+hardening_audit_show_summary: true
+hardening_audit_fetch_report: false
+hardening_audit_controller_report_dir: "{{ playbook_dir }}/hardening-reports"
+```
+
+Set `hardening_audit_fail_on_noncompliance: true` for a strict pipeline. The
+report is written before the role fails. SSH and nginx additionally validate
+their effective configuration with `sshd -T` and `nginx -t`.
+
+The report has no timestamp and is only rewritten when a role produces a new
+configuration change. Re-running an already hardened host therefore produces no
+new file change and leaves the original comparison available.
+
+The acceptance scenario runs against Debian 13, Ubuntu 24.04 and AlmaLinux 9:
+
+```shell
+molecule test -s hardening_audit
+```
+
 ## Contributing to this collection
 
 See the [contributor guideline](CONTRIBUTING.md).

---
- name: Validate hardening audit capture settings
  ansible.builtin.assert:
    that:
      - hardening_audit_role_name is defined
      - hardening_audit_role_name | length > 0
    fail_msg: hardening_audit_role_name must be set when capturing a baseline
    quiet: true
  tags:
    - always
    - hardening_audit

- name: Capture pre-hardening baseline
  devsec.hardening.hardening_audit:
    action: capture
    role: "{{ hardening_audit_role_name }}"
    files: "{{ hardening_audit_role_files }}"
    checks: "{{ hardening_audit_role_checks }}"
    sysctl: "{{ hardening_audit_role_sysctl }}"
    file_expectations: "{{ hardening_audit_role_file_expectations }}"
    command_timeout: "{{ hardening_audit_command_timeout }}"
  register: hardening_audit_capture
  changed_when: false
  check_mode: false
  tags:
    - always
    - hardening_audit

- name: Store pre-hardening baseline
  ansible.builtin.set_fact:
    hardening_audit_before: "{{ hardening_audit_capture.snapshot }}"
  tags:
    - always
    - hardening_audit
---
- name: Compare hardening baseline and write report
  devsec.hardening.hardening_audit:
    action: compare
    role: "{{ hardening_audit_role_name }}"
    before: "{{ hardening_audit_before }}"
    files: "{{ hardening_audit_role_files }}"
    checks: "{{ hardening_audit_role_checks }}"
    sysctl: "{{ hardening_audit_role_sysctl }}"
    file_expectations: "{{ hardening_audit_role_file_expectations }}"
    report_file: "{{ hardening_audit_report_file }}"
    fail_on_noncompliance: "{{ hardening_audit_fail_on_noncompliance | bool }}"
    host: "{{ inventory_hostname }}"
    distribution: "{{ ansible_facts.distribution | default('') }}"
    distribution_version: "{{ ansible_facts.distribution_version | default('') }}"
    os_family: "{{ ansible_facts.os_family | default('') }}"
    command_timeout: "{{ hardening_audit_command_timeout }}"
  register: hardening_audit_result
  when: hardening_audit_before is defined
  tags:
    - always
    - hardening_audit

- name: Store hardening audit result
  ansible.builtin.set_fact:
    hardening_audit_report: "{{ hardening_audit_result.report }}"
    hardening_audit_changes: "{{ hardening_audit_result.changes }}"
    hardening_audit_noncompliant: "{{ hardening_audit_result.noncompliant }}"
  when:
    - hardening_audit_result is defined
    - hardening_audit_result.report is defined
  tags:
    - always
    - hardening_audit

- name: Display hardening audit summary
  ansible.builtin.debug:
    msg: >-
      {{ hardening_audit_role_name }}: {{ hardening_audit_result.summary.changed }}
      changed item(s), {{ hardening_audit_result.summary.noncompliant }}
      noncompliant item(s). Report: {{ hardening_audit_result.report_file }}
  when:
    - hardening_audit_show_summary | bool
    - hardening_audit_result is defined
    - hardening_audit_result.summary is defined
  tags:
    - always
    - hardening_audit

- name: Fetch hardening report to the control node
  ansible.builtin.fetch:
    src: "{{ hardening_audit_report_file }}"
    dest: "{{ hardening_audit_controller_report_dir }}/"
    flat: false
  changed_when: false
  when:
    - hardening_audit_fetch_report | bool
    - hardening_audit_result is defined
    - hardening_audit_result.report_file | length > 0
  tags:
    - always
    - hardening_audit

---
driver:
  name: docker
platforms:
  - name: audit-debian13
    image: rndmh3ro/docker-debian13-ansible:latest
    command: /lib/systemd/systemd
    volumes:
      - /sys/fs/cgroup:/sys/fs/cgroup:rw
    privileged: true
    cgroupns_mode: host
    pre_build_image: true
  - name: audit-ubuntu2404
    image: rndmh3ro/docker-ubuntu2404-ansible:latest
    command: /lib/systemd/systemd
    volumes:
      - /sys/fs/cgroup:/sys/fs/cgroup:rw
    privileged: true
    cgroupns_mode: host
    pre_build_image: true
  - name: audit-almalinux9
    image: rndmh3ro/docker-almalinux9-ansible:latest
    command: /lib/systemd/systemd
    volumes:
      - /sys/fs/cgroup:/sys/fs/cgroup:rw
    privileged: true
    cgroupns_mode: host
    pre_build_image: true
provisioner:
  name: ansible
  options:
    diff: true
  config_options:
    defaults:
      interpreter_python: auto_silent
      callbacks_enabled: profile_tasks, timer
      inject_facts_as_vars: false
verifier:
  name: ansible

scenario:
  create_sequence:
    - dependency
    - create
    - prepare
  check_sequence:
    - dependency
    - destroy
    - create
    - prepare
    - converge
    - check
    - destroy
  converge_sequence:
    - dependency
    - create
    - prepare
    - converge
  destroy_sequence:
    - destroy
  test_sequence:
    - dependency
    - destroy
    - syntax
    - create
    - prepare
    - converge
    - idempotence
    - verify
    - destroy
---
- name: Apply a small but representative hardening surface
  hosts: all
  become: true
  gather_facts: true
  tasks:
    - name: Work around container virtualization detection
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        ansible_virtualization_type: docker

    - name: Include os_hardening role
      ansible.builtin.include_role:
        name: devsec.hardening.os_hardening
  vars:
    hardening_audit_fail_on_noncompliance: true
    os_auditd_enabled: false
    os_apt_enabled: false
    os_cron_enabled: false
    os_ctrlaltdel_disabled: false
    os_limits_enabled: true
    os_login_defs_enabled: true
    os_minimize_access_enabled: false
    os_modprobe_enabled: false
    os_netrc_enabled: false
    os_pam_enabled: false
    os_profile_enabled: true
    os_rhosts_enabled: false
    os_securetty_enabled: false
    os_security_suid_sgid_enforce: false
    os_selinux_enabled: false
    os_sysctl_enabled: true
    os_user_accounts_enabled: false
    os_yum_enabled: false
---
- name: Verify baseline comparison reports on three distributions
  hosts: all
  become: true
  gather_facts: true
  tasks:
    - name: Read the host hardening report
      ansible.builtin.slurp:
        src: /var/log/devsec-hardening/hardening-baseline.json
      register: hardening_report_raw

    - name: Parse the host hardening report
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        hardening_report: "{{ hardening_report_raw.content | b64decode | from_json }}"

    - name: Select login.defs changes
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        pass_max_days_change: >-
          {{
            hardening_report.changes
            | selectattr('id', 'equalto', 'login_defs.PASS_MAX_DAYS')
            | list
          }}
        umask_change: >-
          {{
            hardening_report.changes
            | selectattr('id', 'equalto', 'login_defs.UMASK')
            | list
          }}
        login_defs_file_change: >-
          {{
            hardening_report.file_changes
            | selectattr('path', 'equalto', '/etc/login.defs')
            | list
          }}

    - name: Verify the report identifies the changed configuration items
      ansible.builtin.assert:
        that:
          - hardening_report.host == inventory_hostname
          - hardening_report.distribution == ansible_facts.distribution
          - hardening_report.roles.os_hardening is defined
          - pass_max_days_change | length == 1
          - pass_max_days_change[0].before == '99999'
          - pass_max_days_change[0].after == '60'
          - umask_change | length == 1
          - umask_change[0].before == '022'
          - umask_change[0].after == umask_change[0].expected
          - login_defs_file_change | length == 1
          - login_defs_file_change[0].diff | length > 0
          - hardening_report.noncompliant | length == 0
        fail_msg: >-
          The baseline report did not accurately describe the changes on
          {{ ansible_facts.distribution }} {{ ansible_facts.distribution_version }}

+## Hardening baseline comparison and compliance reports
+
+The four hardening roles automatically capture the relevant configuration
+before they change a host and compare it after they finish. Expected values are
+read from the existing role variables, so existing playbooks keep the same
+override behaviour and do not need a second set of compliance settings.
+
+Each host receives a merged report at
+`/var/log/devsec-hardening/hardening-baseline.json`. It contains:
+
+- before/after hashes, modes and ownership for every captured file;
+- item level changes with the old value, new value and expected value;
+- unified diffs for changed files, including lines not covered by a named check;
+- a `noncompliant` list for values that still differ from the role variables;
+- per-role and aggregate summaries.
+
+The following shared variables control reporting:
+
+```yaml
+hardening_audit_enabled: true
+hardening_audit_fail_on_noncompliance: false
+hardening_audit_report_file: /var/log/devsec-hardening/hardening-baseline.json
+hardening_audit_command_timeout: 30
+hardening_audit_show_summary: true
+hardening_audit_fetch_report: false
+hardening_audit_controller_report_dir: "{{ playbook_dir }}/hardening-reports"
+```
+
+Set `hardening_audit_fail_on_noncompliance: true` for a strict pipeline. The
+report is written before the role fails. SSH and nginx additionally validate
+their effective configuration with `sshd -T` and `nginx -t`.
+
+The report has no timestamp and is only rewritten when a role produces a new
+configuration change. Re-running an already hardened host therefore produces no
+new file change and leaves the original comparison available.
+
+The acceptance scenario runs against Debian 13, Ubuntu 24.04 and AlmaLinux 9:
+
+```shell
+molecule test -s hardening_audit
+```
+

    files: "{{ hardening_audit_role_files }}"

scenario:
  create_sequence:
    - dependency
    - create
    - prepare
  check_sequence:
    - dependency
    - destroy
    - create
    - prepare
    - converge
    - check
    - destroy
  converge_sequence:
    - dependency
    - create
    - prepare
    - converge
  destroy_sequence:
    - destroy
  test_sequence:
    - dependency
    - destroy
    - syntax
    - create
    - prepare
    - converge
    - idempotence
    - verify
    - destroy
---
- name: Apply a small but representative hardening surface
  hosts: all
  become: true
  gather_facts: true
  tasks:
    - name: Work around container virtualization detection
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        ansible_virtualization_type: docker

    - name: Include os_hardening role
      ansible.builtin.include_role:
        name: devsec.hardening.os_hardening
  vars:
    hardening_audit_fail_on_noncompliance: true
    os_auditd_enabled: false
    os_apt_enabled: false
    os_cron_enabled: false
    os_ctrlaltdel_disabled: false
    os_limits_enabled: true
    os_login_defs_enabled: true
    os_minimize_access_enabled: false
    os_modprobe_enabled: false
    os_netrc_enabled: false
    os_pam_enabled: false
    os_profile_enabled: true
    os_rhosts_enabled: false
    os_securetty_enabled: false
    os_security_suid_sgid_enforce: false
    os_selinux_enabled: false
    os_sysctl_enabled: true
    os_user_accounts_enabled: false
    os_yum_enabled: false
---
- name: Verify baseline comparison reports on three distributions
  hosts: all
  become: true
  gather_facts: true
  tasks:
    - name: Read the host hardening report
      ansible.builtin.slurp:
        src: /var/log/devsec-hardening/hardening-baseline.json
      register: hardening_report_raw

    - name: Parse the host hardening report
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        hardening_report: "{{ hardening_report_raw.content | b64decode | from_json }}"

    - name: Select login.defs changes
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        pass_max_days_change: >-
          {{
            hardening_report.changes
            | selectattr('id', 'equalto', 'login_defs.PASS_MAX_DAYS')
            | list
          }}
        umask_change: >-
          {{
            hardening_report.changes
            | selectattr('id', 'equalto', 'login_defs.UMASK')
            | list
          }}
        login_defs_file_change: >-
          {{
            hardening_report.file_changes
            | selectattr('path', 'equalto', '/etc/login.defs')
            | list
          }}

    - name: Verify the report identifies the changed configuration items
      ansible.builtin.assert:
        that:
          - hardening_report.host == inventory_hostname
          - hardening_report.distribution == ansible_facts.distribution
          - hardening_report.roles.os_hardening is defined
          - pass_max_days_change | length == 1
          - pass_max_days_change[0].before == '99999'
          - pass_max_days_change[0].after == '60'
          - umask_change | length == 1
          - umask_change[0].before == '022'
          - umask_change[0].after == umask_change[0].expected
          - login_defs_file_change | length == 1
          - login_defs_file_change[0].diff | length > 0
          - hardening_report.noncompliant | length == 0
        fail_msg: >-
          The baseline report did not accurately describe the changes on
          {{ ansible_facts.distribution }} {{ ansible_facts.distribution_version }}
